rules.name: cs-18-leg-mtm-legacy-vs-new-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.premium AS traded_price, -1 * a.active_lots AS active_lots, CASE WHEN si.derivative_type IN ('future', 'cs_future') AND :valueDate > si.maturity_date THEN fp.last_price ELSE h.settle_price END AS settle_price, m.mult_factor AS mult_factor, m.nc_factor AS nc_factor, fx.fx_nc_factor AS fx_nc_factor, (((CASE WHEN si.derivative_type IN ('future', 'cs_future') AND :valueDate > si.maturity_date THEN fp.last_price ELSE h.settle_price END) - d.premium) * (-1 * a.active_lots) * m.mult_factor * m.nc_factor * IFNULL(fx.fx_nc_factor, 1) * -1) AS mtm_usd FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN (SELECT x.trade_id, x.active_lots FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs x JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(value_date) AS value_date FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs WHERE value_date <= :valueDate GROUP BY trade_id) mx ON mx.trade_id = x.trade_id AND mx.value_date = x.value_date) a ON a.trade_id = d.trade_id LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs cs ON cs.security_id = d.security_id LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.security_info_table_cfs si ON si.security_id = d.security_id LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs h ON h.security_id = d.security_id AND h.value_date = :valueDate LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.futures_price_table fp ON fp.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id AND fp.value_date = si.maturity_date LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.helper_otc_multiplier_view m ON m.invenio_product_code = cs.product_code LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.fx_nc_factor_view_cfs fx ON fx.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE si.derivative_type = 'future' AND d.transaction_date < :valueDate AND d.counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400' AND d.subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND ((cs.maturity_date IS NULL AND d.netting_status <> 'fully_netted') OR (d.netting_status = 'fully_netted' AND d.netting_date > :valueDate) OR (:valueDate <= cs.maturity_date AND d.netting_status IN ('not_netted', 'partially_netted')))

SELECT c.trade_id, c.contract_number, c.traded_price, c.active_lots, c.settle_price, c.mult_factor, c.nc_factor, c.fx_nc_factor, c.mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.derivative_type = 'future'
